title: Proposed Automated Sample Preparation and SEM Imaging Workflow for Semiconductor Wafers
content: The advancement of semiconductor technology demands rapid, high-resolution imaging for quality control and failure detection at the nanoscale, yet traditional SEM-based wafer inspection remains labor-intensive, requiring skilled operators and manual intervention [1]. This paper proposes an automated workflow integrating robotic sample handling, ML-driven imaging adjustments, and AI-based defect classification to enhance throughput, reproducibility, and accuracy. As semiconductor devices shrink and increase in complexity, precise and reproducible imaging becomes critical, especially for 3D ICs and advanced packaging solutions [4]. Conventional SEM workflows suffer from operator variability, misalignment, and inefficiencies, leading to inconsistent data quality and long processing times, hindering high-throughput wafer analysis.
